## Activity

During July 2025, East City Eye Clinic completed 180 captures. This activity represents the recorded imaging work undertaken at the site during the reporting month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The activity record should be retained with the routine site operations information for East City Eye Clinic.

## Image quality

Of the 180 captures completed, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7 per cent. This result should be monitored through routine quality review, with attention given to any recurring issues that may affect the ability to obtain images suitable for assessment. The reported rate and count should be considered together when reviewing performance for July 2025.

## Grading

A total of 56 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and turnaround for the reporting month. Continued review of referable results and grading timeliness will support oversight of activity at East City Eye Clinic.
